description: Life-Architect Registry v4.0. Unified control for Professional Design, AI Art, Music, and Family Legacy.

get_system_vitals.description: Detailed CPU, RAM, and Temperature report from Fortress

get_gpu_metrics.description: Current VRAM usage and GPU load (Nvidia-SMI)

list_network_connections.description: List all active TCP/UDP connections on Fortress

get_os_version.description: Get detailed Windows Build and Version info

deep_search_vault.description: High-speed recursive text search using ripgrep across the Nexus

ollama_pull_model.description: Download a new model from Ollama library

ollama_run_inference.description: Directly prompt a local model and return text

screenshot_url.description: Render a URL and save as image on Fortress

run_scheduled_task.description: Trigger a Windows Scheduled Task manually

get_event_viewer_logs.description: Read Windows Event Viewer logs for errors

list_installed_software.description: List all installed applications on Fortress

manage_registry_key.description: Read or Write a Windows Registry key

ping_network_device.description: Ping another device on the local network from Fortress

check_print_resolution.description: Scan labels for print-ready DPI (300dpi check)

palette_extractor.description: Extract dominant color palette from image for design

sample_library_search.description: Deep-search music sample folders by keyword

family_milestone_log.description: Log a child's milestone to the family ledger

list_comfyui_workflows.description: List the workflow JSON files saved in ComfyUI's workflow folder, with each file's format (api, ui or invalid).

directory.description: Accepted for contract compatibility but IGNORED — the folder is fixed to ComfyUI's user/default/workflows.

read_comfyui_workflow.description: Read a saved ComfyUI workflow and report its nodes and prompt text. Accepts a bare file name or an absolute path. Reports whether it is runnable.

workflow_path.description: File name inside ComfyUI's workflow folder, or an absolute path inside it.

run_comfyui_workflow.description: Submit an API-format graph to ComfyUI /prompt and return its prompt_id. A UI-format workflow is refused rather than sent to fail.

workflow.description: API-format graph: {node_id: {class_type, inputs}}. Required unless workflow_path is given.

workflow_path.description: Saved API-format workflow to run instead of an inline graph.

get_comfyui_queue.description: Report ComfyUI's queue: what is running and what is pending.

get_comfyui_history.description: Report finished ComfyUI jobs and the output image references they produced.

prompt_id.description: One job id; omit for the recent list.

list_comfyui_models.description: List the model files ComfyUI has on disk: checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs and embeddings.

list_comfyui_nodes.description: List available ComfyUI node types and categories, or one node's full input schema when class_type is given.

class_type.description: One node type, to return its full input schema.

category.description: Filter the list to one category.

save_comfyui_workflow.description: Save a workflow JSON into ComfyUI's workflow folder. Refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true.

name.description: File name to write inside the workflow folder.

edit_comfyui_workflow.description: Change an API-format workflow in place: swap checkpoint or LoRA, set positive/negative prompt, set a seed, or change the output prefix. Refuses a UI-format file.

workflow_path.description: File name or absolute path of the API-format workflow.

changes.description: Accepted keys: checkpoint, lora{name,strength_model,strength_clip}, positive_prompt, negative_prompt, prompts[{node_id,text}], seed{node_id,value}, filename_prefix.

positive_prompt.description: Replaces the text of the first CLIPTextEncode node.

negative_prompt.description: Replaces the second CLIPTextEncode node (falls back to the first if there is only one).

upload_comfyui_image.description: Upload an input image into ComfyUI's input folder, from a local file path or from base64.

get_comfyui_output_image.description: Fetch a generated image from ComfyUI by filename and save it locally.

cancel_comfyui_job.description: Interrupt a running ComfyUI job, or remove a queued one. With no prompt_id, interrupts the running job and clears pending.

prompt_id.description: Job to stop or remove; omit to interrupt everything.

queue_only.description: Clear pending jobs rather than interrupt the running one.

trim_video.description: Trim a clip to a start/end range with ffmpeg. If output_path is omitted the result is written beside the source as <name>_trimmed.mp4.

video_path.description: Source video under an allowed root.

end.description: End offset in seconds (or pass duration instead).

duration.description: Length to keep, if no end.

concat_video.description: Join two or more clips in order with ffmpeg. If output_path is omitted the result is written beside the first clip as <name>_joined.mp4.

search_music_catalog.description: Search the Fortress song catalog (43 songs) by title or lyric text.

create_pdf.description: Create a PDF from markdown or plain text, by building a document and converting it with LibreOffice.

content.description: Markdown or plain text. '# ' becomes the title, '## ' headings, '- ' bullets.

create_docx.description: Create a Word document from markdown or plain text.

create_spreadsheet.description: Create an .xlsx workbook from one or more sheets.

create_presentation.description: Create a .pptx deck. Each slide's body is split on newlines into bullets.

deploy_website.description: Publish a site and return its URL. Requires Chrissy's approval (kernel execution grant). NOTE: netlify CLI is NOT installed on FORTRESS; only vercel and wrangler exist.

project_path.description: Site directory under an allowed root.

platform.description: Which CLI to deploy with. cloudflare is also accepted.

git_checkout.description: Switch a repository to an existing branch. Requires Chrissy's approval.

repo_path.description: Repository directory containing .git, under an allowed root.

git_branch.description: List branches, or create one and switch to it. Requires Chrissy's approval.

action.description: Default: create when name is given, list otherwise.

git_merge.description: Merge a branch into the current one with --no-edit. Requires Chrissy's approval.

git_push.description: Push the current branch to a remote. Never forces. Requires Chrissy's approval.

git_pull.description: Fast-forward-only pull from a remote, so it can never create a surprise merge. Requires Chrissy's approval.

query_local_database.description: Run one read-only SELECT/WITH query against an allowlisted local sqlite database. Refuses PRAGMA, ATTACH, written statements and stacked statements.

database_path.description: One of the three allowlisted FortressTerminal sqlite files.

query.description: A single SELECT or WITH statement.

workspace_info.description: Report the approved workspace this desktop is bound to, and its limits.

read_text_file.description: Read a text file from the approved workspace and return its contents.

path.description: File path inside the approved workspace.

write_text_file.description: Write a text file, replacing it entirely. Backs the previous version up first. To add to a file use append_text_file; to change part of one use edit_text_file.

path.description: File path inside the approved workspace.

expected_sha256.description: Optional guard: refuse to write unless the current file hashes to this.

edit_text_file.description: Replace one exact substring inside a text file. Refuses if old_text is absent or appears more than once.

path.description: File path inside the approved workspace.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace; must appear exactly once.

new_text.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete).

append_text_file.description: Add text to the end of a file without replacing what is there.

path.description: File path inside the approved workspace.

run_git.description: Read-only git status for a repository in the workspace. The action is fixed: this tool can never reach history, the index or a remote.

path.description: Repository path inside the approved workspace.

action.description: Always "status"; any other value is refused.

run_python.description: Run one Python unittest file from the workspace. The action is fixed to unittest, and the test file name must match ^test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py$ so it can name no path and no flag.

test_file.description: Test file name only, no path.
